fixes.explanation: Rebuilding is a good word, but it isn't in this verse. Joshua says the LORD will push those nations out and drive them out so Israel can take possession of their land (Joshua 23:5). The word for the blank is possess. Joshua says nothing here about what Israel will build. I'd love to rebuild my bakery too, but that's me talking, not Joshua.

problems.problem: “Rebuilding comes after you own the place” presents rebuilding as a later step, but Joshua does not say Israel will rebuild the land.
